title: Guarantee Deadlines, Overset and Attrition Figures — Private Event & Banquet Services
content:
The kitchen buys, rosters and sets a room against the guaranteed guest count, and the figures printed against each Private Event & Banquet Services package for that count are set out here.

| Package | Guarantee deadline, hours before the event | Share of the guaranteed count still charged when fewer guests attend, per cent | Places set above the guaranteed count, per cent | Shortfall absorbed without charge, per cent | Guests included in a complimentary menu tasting | Tasting held by, calendar days before the event |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Meeting Room Refreshment Package | 24 | 80 | 0 | 10 | 0 | 0 |
| Boardroom Reception Package | 48 | 85 | 3 | 10 | 0 | 0 |
| Conference Day Delegate Package | 72 | 90 | 5 | 8 | 2 | 21 |
| Seated Banquet Package | 96 | 95 | 5 | 5 | 4 | 30 |
| Gala Reception Package | 120 | 100 | 3 | 3 | 6 | 45 |
| Multi-Day Conference Residency Package | 168 | 95 | 5 | 5 | 8 | 60 |

The deadline column is the hours before the event by which the final guaranteed guest count must be given. The shortfall column is the share of the guaranteed count still charged when fewer guests attend, as a percentage. The overset column is the places set and prepared above the guaranteed count, as a percentage of that count. The attrition column is the shortfall against a contracted room or cover block absorbed without charge, as a percentage. The last two columns are the guests included in a complimentary menu tasting and the calendar days before the event by which a tasting must be held.

Deadline and attrition move against one another across the packages. The Gala Reception Package gives the longest working notice of the standard packages at 120 hours and absorbs the least at 3 per cent, while the Meeting Room Refreshment Package gives 24 hours and absorbs 10 per cent. The Gala Reception Package is also the only package charging the whole of the guaranteed count, at 100 per cent, where the Meeting Room Refreshment Package charges 80 per cent of it.

Two packages include no complimentary tasting guests and print no tasting window, standing at 0 in both columns: the Meeting Room Refreshment Package and the Boardroom Reception Package. The Meeting Room Refreshment Package alone sets no places above the guaranteed count, printing 0 in the overset column.
